title: Bringing the conversation into one picture
meaning: An attentive exchange of details can lead to a whole understanding in which separate remarks finally find their place.
text: Conversation brings a particular relief when scattered words form an understandable whole. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha develops the exchange of details: telling a story, asking questions and finding a continuation for the other person’s thought. The Hermit in energy helps you seek what matters behind those remarks instead of settling for the first convenient explanation. The World in emotions gives a sense of completion. Different parts of the story fit together, allowing you to feel that the subject has been discussed and both people have a place in the picture.

For example, after confusion about an invitation, you work out who heard what and when each person replied. Separate fragments of messages find a clear sequence. **A whole conversation lets you stop filling the gaps alone.** You can acknowledge your own part in the misunderstanding while keeping the rest of the exchange in view. The evening can continue quietly, with the actual promise distinguished from a detail each had merely assumed.

The vulnerable point is seeking such a complete picture that discussion never ends. One more detail seems likely to explain everything although the central agreement is already clear. The search for understanding then deprives you both of closure. A sufficiently whole answer preserves meaning and leaves small inaccuracies free to occupy less of the evening.
